freeze_discipline.why: The three-domain campaign was executed and frozen before this packet existed. This lane runs nothing and re-derives nothing.
freeze_discipline.prospectivity_disclosure: Outcomes were readable before the theorems were written. Section 4 is explanatory classification, NOT prediction. No prospectivity is claimed.
freeze_discipline.policy_selection_disclosure: All three policies present in the frozen campaign are classified. None was added, dropped or redefined.
post_outcome_changes_forbidden: reclassifying a policy after seeing its counts
dropping the flask domain because it is the least favourable

claims_under_test: Theorem 1: preservation plus consecutive bridging implies final closure for arbitrary finite chains.
Theorem 2: with one bridge link broken there is a chain where every pairwise step succeeds and global closure fails.
Theorem 3: reordering the same transforms can break a bridge that held.
Classification: exact containment is sound and exact in all three domains; coarse containment is unsound where the dependency structure separates the tests.

information_matching.requirement_1649: strongest fair baselines must be information/action/budget matched
information_matching.how_satisfied: always-reopen receives strictly MORE budget (it reopens everything) and is the safety upper bound; donor-coarse and exact-containment decide the SAME frozen transitions on the SAME dependency graphs, differing only in the exactness of the containment test. The comparison isolates test exactness, not information.

explicitly_not_claimed: that the chain theory is a new verification paradigm; the contribution is a composition condition and its necessity
any deployed-agent or open-world navigation claim beyond the bounded paper
novelty over assume-guarantee / contract-based compositional verification

independent_checker_requirements.independence_rule: No ORION-17 module imported. Chain theorems verified on freshly enumerated chains; campaign read as data only.
independent_checker_requirements.witness_rule: Theorems 2 and 3 must be established by EXHIBITED witnesses, not assertions
independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: exit code 3, status CANNOT_CHECK, never reported as a pass

stop_rule_1649_verbatim: If arbitrary-chain behaviour adds no new consequence beyond pairwise theory, keep the bounded paper and do not inflate the contribution.
stop_rule_evaluation: Arbitrary-chain behaviour DOES add a new consequence: Theorem 2 shows pairwise success does not compose, with an exhibited witness, and Theorem 3 shows order is load-bearing. Neither follows from the pairwise theory. The contribution is stated at exactly that size.
